higherIsNotBetter.description: True if a {@link MlCustomMetric} needs to be higher to be better.

noTarget.description: True if a {@link MlCustomMetric} does not use `targetOutput` when calling {@link #doScore}.

contextNames.description: List of valid context names that a {@link MlCustomMetric} supports.

targetOutputNames.description: List of valid target output names for multi-input custom metric.

modelOutputNames.description: List of valid model output names for multi-input custom metric.
